thread:
maya: Quick mid‑quarter check — need a short status on the Shipline milestone for the OKR. What actually shipped vs slipped, who owns followups, and any blockers? TL;DR please.

alex: Shipped: batching improvements + new model routing rule. Deployed to prod yesterday. Perf looks stable so far. PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/482 :rocket:

sam: Slipped: private deployments rollout — blocked by infra cert rotation. ETA +2 weeks unless security clears staged KMS swap. Owner: sam + lina.

lina: Working on the cert rotation now. Need an approval from security for the staged key swap and a canary region. @tj can you confirm we got signoff?

tj: Security gave provisional approval for a staged swap. Requirement: canary in us-west-2 only, watch metrics 24h, then expand. ok to proceed with that constraint.

maya: Ok good — canary constraint noted. Please add a brief rollout plan to the ticket (steps + rollback).

alex: CR ping: I added a small config change touching autoscale policies in infra PR 490. @sam can you review the change that affects min/max scaling? Link: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/490

sam: On my list today, will review and post comments by EOD.

priya: QA note — we'll run regression on chat, streaming, and embeddings post-canary. Need a concise test checklist. @maya can you drop the customer flows to cover?

maya: Adding checklist now in the ticket: `login -> load model -> streaming -> tool call -> embeddings compare`. Also include perf smoke (p95/p99) and end-to-end latency.

deploy-bot: deploy started: infra/batching v2 -> canary us-west-2 at 2024-11-11T15:03Z

alex: Canary looks good after 2h: median latency -6%, errors stable. Rolling to 3 additional regions.

lina: Heads up — dedicated capacity schedule conflict with a Dedicated customer maintenance window on 2024-11-25. We should notify CS and avoid big changes that day. @maya can you coordinate comms?

maya: Will draft the customer note and ping CS now. Also proposing a rolling freeze 2024-11-24 -> 2024-11-26 for safety. Thoughts?

tj: Agree on freeze window. Next steps: sam + lina own cert work, alex owns rollout orchestration, maya handles comms, priya owns QA signoff. I will update the OKR board and the milestone card with new ETAs and owners.

maya: :thumbsup: Thanks — please update tickets so we have a single source of truth. Anything else?

alex: One extra ask — bump priority on ticket #426 (model quantization regressions) so we don't regress perf after the routing change. I'll file a follow-up.

sam: Noted, I'll add it to this sprint backlog.

maya: Closing this thread — update the relevant tickets by EOD. We'll do a brief sync if anything shows up. Thanks everyone!
